# rules-frontend.md — mis-frontend (Vue 3 + Vite, frontend)

<!-- Generated by ONBOARDING.md (Phase 5) from wiki/raw/repo-profiles/fe.rules-draft.md + decisions-log.md (2026-10-16). Every rule cites the file it was derived from, or says "framework default", "reference (enrollment-fe)" or "decided 2026-10-16". Edit freely, and keep the citations. -->

Binding for every agent and human working in this repo. `rules-common.md` applies too; where they conflict, this file wins for this repo.

This repo adopts enrollment-fe's FE rules (decided 2026-10-16). The RFID assignment UI is rebuilt with the same UX as `enrollment-fe/src/views/student/Student.vue`, with the deviations listed in §3. Do not copy reference code blindly.

---

## 1. Stack

- Language / runtime: JavaScript (ES modules, no TypeScript) (`package.json`). Node 20.19+ or 22.12+, required by Vite 8 (`README.md`).
- Framework: Vue ^3.5.42 with `<script setup>` SFCs on Vite ^8.3.0 (`@vitejs/plugin-vue` ^6); vue-router ^5.4, Pinia ^4.1, axios ^1.20, Tailwind ^4.3.3 via `@tailwindcss/vite`, laravel-echo ^2.4 + pusher-js ^8.6 (`package.json`, `vite.config.js`). Toasts: `vue-toastification` 2.0.0-rc.5 (decided 2026-10-16; installed in MIS-1). **No Vuetify** (decided 2026-10-16) — its registration in `src/main.js` and the `vuetify` dependency are removed.
- Package manager: npm (`package-lock.json`); keep `.npmrc` `legacy-peer-deps=true`.
- Database: none. All data comes from mis-backend at `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL` (`.env.example`; decided 2026-10-16).
- Commands: dev `npm run dev` (port 5173) · test none · lint none · build `npm run build` (`package.json`).

## 2. Layer Chain (build order)

1. api-service
2. store? (only for state shared across pages or persisted)
3. component
4. view
5. route
6. layout? (only when a page needs a panel layout or sidebar)

| Layer | Folder | Naming | Base / Wiring | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| api-service | `src/services/` | `http.js` (the one client) + `<domain>Service.js` exporting verb-named `async` functions (`fetchStudents`, `updateStudentRfid`, `openRfidChannel`, `closeRfidChannel`) | `<domain>Service.js` imports the shared client from `@/services/http.js` | reference (enrollment-fe) `src/services/userApiService.js`; decided 2026-10-16 |
| store | `src/stores/` | `<name>Store.js` exporting `use<Name>Store` | Pinia options API, registered by `createPinia()` in `src/main.js` | reference (enrollment-fe) `src/stores/userStore.js` |
| component | `src/components/[<group>/]` | PascalCase `.vue`; groups such as `modal/` | `<script setup>`, `defineProps`/`defineEmits`/slots; presentational | reference (enrollment-fe) `src/components/modal/Modal.vue` |
| view | `src/views/[<role>/]` | PascalCase `.vue`, lowercase role folder | `<script setup>`; calls services, holds page state, fetches in `onMounted`/`watch` | reference (enrollment-fe) `src/views/student/Student.vue` |
| route | `src/router.js` | `name` PascalCase, `path` kebab-case | `createRouter({ history: createWebHistory(), routes })`; rendered through `<router-view />` in `App.vue` | `src/router.js` |
| layout | `src/layout/`, `src/layout/sidebar/` | `<Name>PanelLayout.vue`, `<Role>Sidebar.vue` | parent route component with child routes | reference (enrollment-fe) `src/layout/MainPanelLayout.vue` |

## 3. Layer Rules

- **api-service**
  - Only services make HTTP calls; components and views never import axios.
  - Exactly one axios client: `src/services/http.js`, `baseURL` from `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL`. No other `axios.create` anywhere (decided 2026-10-16).
  - A service function returns `response.data` and lets failures reject, keeping the server's message (reference (enrollment-fe) returned a generic `Error` that dropped it — do not copy).
- **realtime (part of api-service)**
  - Echo is constructed with `broadcaster: 'pusher'`; key, cluster, host, port and scheme come from `import.meta.env.VITE_PUSHER_*` (`.env.example`; decided 2026-10-16). Never hardcode them.
  - The RFID flow listens on public channel `rfid` for event `AssignRfid` and reads `e.message` as the UID (reference (enrollment-fe) `Student.vue`).
  - The page **leaves the channel on unmount**, and **calls `closeRfidChannel` (`/rfid/close`) when the modal closes** (decided 2026-10-16; the reference did neither).
- **store** — only cross-page state goes in a store. Page-local lists and RFID modal state stay in page `ref`s (reference (enrollment-fe) `Student.vue`).
- **component** — presentational: props in, emits/slots out; no service calls (reference (enrollment-fe) `RfidScanPromt.vue`, `Modal.vue`).
- **view**
  - Gets data only through services.
  - Shows a loading state while fetching and reports success/failure to the user with `vue-toastification` (decided 2026-10-16).
- **route** — register every page in `src/router.js`; `App.vue` renders `<router-view />` (the generator `App.vue` renders `HelloWorld` directly — replace it).
- **Build order (decided 2026-10-16)** — auth first: login page, token in the `http.js` interceptors, user/role state in a Pinia store, and router guards for admin/registrar. Then the students page, modal, RFID scan prompt and table.
- **Styling** — Tailwind utility classes only, via `@import "tailwindcss"` (`src/style.css`). No Vuetify components, directives or styles (decided 2026-10-16). Remove the generator demo CSS in `src/style.css` before building real pages. Every page follows the **Ledger** visual style in §9 (decided 2026-11-01).
- **Imports** — use the `@/` alias for `src/` (decided 2026-10-16). Add it to `vite.config.js` `resolve.alias` before the first import that needs it (no alias exists today).

## 4. Data & Validation

- Where input is validated: in the view, before the service call, returning early with a toast — e.g. the assign action refuses when no UID was scanned (reference (enrollment-fe) `Student.vue`). mis-backend is authoritative.
- Where persistence happens: on mis-backend, through services.
- Response / error shape: services return `response.data`; axios rejects on non-2xx (framework default). Laravel validation errors are 422 `{message, errors}` (framework default).
- Pagination / unbounded queries: use server pagination once mis-backend offers it; until then a client-side slice like the reference is acceptable (reference (enrollment-fe) `Student.vue`).

## 5. Cross-cutting

- Auth: Sanctum token from mis-backend `/api/mis/login`, attached in the `src/services/http.js` interceptors; auth is the first ticket (decided 2026-10-16).
- Authorisation / permissions: router guards by role; admin/registrar for the student and RFID pages (same roles as the reference `role:admin,registrar`).
- Scoping / tenancy: none.
- Logging: no client logger and no `console.*` in committed code (decided 2026-10-16; rules-common 14). Failures are reported to the user by toast in the failure branch.
- Config / secrets: never hardcode; read from `import.meta.env.VITE_*` and document every variable in `.env.example`. `.env` is gitignored; agents never read it (`.gitignore`).

## 6. Tests

- Framework: none configured (`package.json`).
- Location & naming: n/a until a runner exists.
- Required per change: `npm run build` passes on Node ≥ 20.19, and the changed page is checked by hand in `npm run dev` against a running mis-backend (and Pusher for the RFID flow).
- Fixtures / factories: none.

## 7. Prohibitions

- No HTTP calls from components or views; no `axios.create` outside `src/services/http.js` (decided 2026-10-16).
- No Vuetify — no components, directives (`v-tooltip` included) or `vuetify/styles` (decided 2026-10-16).
- No `console.*` and no `debugger` in committed code (decided 2026-10-16; rules-common 14).
- No hardcoded API URLs, Pusher keys or clusters (the reference hardcodes the Pusher key in `Student.vue`; do not copy it).
- No relative `../` imports into `src/` once the `@/` alias exists (decided 2026-10-16).
- No reading or committing `.env` (`.gitignore`).
- Do not copy `enrollment-fe` code blindly; rebuild against these rules and record any deliberate behaviour change.
- No raw hex/rgb colors, arbitrary values (`bg-[#…]`, `p-[13px]`) or inline `style` colors in components — use the §9 theme tokens and Tailwind's scale. No second accent color, gradients, emoji icons or decorative shadows on cards.

## 8. Self-Audit Checklist

Run on every touched file before finishing.

- [ ] SFC uses `<script setup>`; imports use `@/`
- [ ] HTTP only through a `src/services/<domain>Service.js` function on the shared `http.js` client
- [ ] Base URL and Pusher config from `import.meta.env.VITE_*`; any new variable added to `.env.example`
- [ ] Tailwind only; no Vuetify
- [ ] Route registered in `src/router.js` and reachable through `<router-view>`
- [ ] Every async call has a loading state and a toast on success and failure
- [ ] RFID flow: channel opened before the prompt shows; missing UID refused before the PUT; list refreshed after assignment; `/rfid/close` called on modal close; Echo channel left on unmount
- [ ] No `console.*`, no hardcoded URL or key
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds on Node ≥ 20.19
- [ ] Ledger style (§9): colors only from the theme tokens, status shown with the standard chips, page sits inside `MainPanelLayout` with title in the top bar, works at 400px width, visible focus ring on every control

## 9. Visual Design — Ledger (decided 2026-11-01)

Light, calm office software: white surfaces, a light grey page, one blue accent. The data and the attendance status colors are the only loud things on screen. Reference mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/6DvLHSjN1wtMZDGJvXLYxa (style "Ledger").

**Theme tokens** — define once in `src/style.css` with Tailwind v4 `@theme`, then use them as classes (`bg-surface`, `text-ink-muted`, `bg-accent`…). Components never use hex values.

```css
@theme {
  --color-page: #f7f8fa;        /* app background */
  --color-surface: #ffffff;     /* sidebar, top bar, cards, tables */
  --color-line: #e3e6eb;        /* every border and table rule */
  --color-ink: #18202c;         /* body text */
  --color-ink-muted: #67707f;   /* secondary text, table headers, captions */
  --color-accent: #1d4fcf;      /* primary buttons, active nav, links, focus ring */
  --color-accent-soft: #eaf0fd; /* active nav background, selected rows */
  --font-sans: "Manrope Variable", "Manrope", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;  /* RFID UIDs, codes */
}
```

**Status chips** (semantic, separate from the accent — same everywhere): Present `bg-green-100 text-green-800`, Late `bg-amber-100 text-amber-800`, Absent `bg-red-100 text-red-800`, Timed out / neutral `bg-slate-200 text-slate-700`. Pill shape `rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold`. Never color alone — always a word.

**Shell** (`src/layout/MainPanelLayout.vue`):
- Sidebar `w-58` (≈232px), `bg-surface border-r border-line`; groups with uppercase `text-xs tracking-wider text-ink-muted` headings; items `rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-sm` with an icon; active item `bg-accent-soft text-accent font-semibold` plus a 3px left accent edge. Items come from one nav config filtered by the user's roles.
- Below `md`, the sidebar collapses to an icon rail / drawer; it never pushes the page sideways.
- Top bar `bg-surface border-b border-line px-6 py-3.5`: breadcrumb + page title (`text-lg font-bold`) on the left; school-year badge, scanner status and user menu (name, roles, Logout) on the right.
- Content `p-6 gap-4` (`p-3.5` on phones), on `bg-page`.

**Components**:
- Cards and panels: `bg-surface border border-line rounded-lg` — no shadow. Panel header row `px-4 py-3 border-b border-line` with title left, actions right.
- Tables: header `text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-muted bg-page`, rows `border-t border-line`, `tabular-nums` for times and counts, UIDs in `font-mono text-xs`; wrap wide tables in `overflow-x-auto`.
- Buttons: primary `bg-accent text-white rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold`; secondary `border border-line bg-surface`; destructive `bg-red-600 text-white`. One primary button per view area.
- Inputs: `border border-line rounded-md bg-surface px-3 py-2`, label above, error text `text-red-700 text-xs` below.
- Focus: every interactive element shows `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-accent ring-offset-1`.
- Radius scale: `rounded-md` (controls), `rounded-lg` (cards), `rounded-full` (chips, avatars). Nothing larger.

**Typography**: Manrope (self-hosted via `@fontsource-variable/manrope` when the shell ticket adds it; system font fallback). Sizes: page title `text-lg`/`font-bold`, panel title `text-sm font-bold`, body `text-sm`, captions `text-xs`. Numbers in tables and stat tiles use `tabular-nums`.

**Icons**: `@lucide/vue` only (replaces the deprecated `lucide-vue-next`, decided 2026-11-01), 16–18px, `stroke-width` default; no emoji.
